bounds_and_conditions.LDO_ground_basis: TPS7A16 table gives15uA max at10uA output; loaded100mA ground5uA is typical only.1mA is explicit planning margin, not a guaranteed new component bound.
bounds_and_conditions.buck_efficiency_basis: TI LMR36506 RevC §7.3.10 uses.8 as conservative normal light-load estimate; not guaranteed full-corner efficiency. Bias reservation50uA covers listed nonswitchingVIN/EN/BIAS rows once; switching/load losses already represented by.8.
bounds_and_conditions.isolator_basis: Largest listed DC/1/10/100Mbps same-side maxima;100Mbps cases atCL15pF. This preserves8.333MHzSPI and does not interpolate a lower current. Mixed-state/load/capacitance actual dynamic guarantee remains open.
